source.name: Footy Headlines: In-House Buriram United 26-27 Home Kit Revealed
source.quote: The home shirt retains the club's traditional look, featuring the classic crest and signature sponsor logos on the chest.
source.note: The article's club-watermarked launch photos show the Chang logo (two elephants, palm tree and 'Chang' wordmark) across the chest centre; the away-kit launch article by the same outlet (24 Aug 2026) describes 'the central Chang sponsor logo' and the club's partners page lists Chang as TITLE SPONSOR (buriramunited.com/en/partner).

source.name: Footy Headlines: In-House Buriram United 26-27 Home Kit Revealed
source.quote: The home shirt retains the club's traditional look, featuring the classic crest and signature sponsor logos on the chest.
source.note: The launch photos show the Yamaha tuning-fork logo with 'YAMAHA' text on the wearer's right chest (opposite the crest). The companion away-kit article names 'Yamaha chest branding' and the club's partners page lists Yamaha Motor Thailand as a MAIN SPONSOR.

source.name: Footy Headlines: In-House Buriram United 26-27 Home Kit Revealed
source.quote: The home shirt retains the club's traditional look, featuring the classic crest and signature sponsor logos on the chest.
source.note: The launch photos show a red 'SAMART' wordmark on the lower front hem of the shirt. The club's partners page lists Samart (linking to samartcorp.com) among its sponsors.

source.name: Footy Headlines: In-House Buriram United 26-27 Home Kit Revealed
source.quote: The home shirt retains the club's traditional look, featuring the classic crest and signature sponsor logos on the chest.
source.note: The launch photos show Muang Thai's red rounded-rectangle logo with white Thai script on the right sleeve. The club's partners page lists Muang Thai Life Assurance (linking to webmtl.co) as a MAIN SPONSOR.

source.name: Footy Headlines: In-House Buriram United 26-27 Home Kit Revealed
source.quote: The home shirt retains the club's traditional look, featuring the classic crest and signature sponsor logos on the chest.
source.note: The 'Dunlopillo' wordmark appears on the left sleeve; clearest on the pink away kit shown in the same outlet's 24 Aug 2026 away-kit article, where the '...pillo' text ends the cursive logo. The club's partners page lists Dunlopillo (dunlopillo.co.th) as a MAIN SPONSOR.

source.name: Footy Headlines: In-House Buriram United 26-27 Home Kit Revealed
source.quote: The home shirt retains the club's traditional look, featuring the classic crest and signature sponsor logos on the chest.
source.note: One launch photo shows the back of a numbered shirt: the 'AIS' logo with its red swoosh is printed below the collar, above the player name and number. AIS also appears in the club's partners strip (logo file dated 3 Aug 2026).

source.name: Footy Headlines: In-House Buriram United 26-27 Home Kit Revealed
source.quote: The home shirt retains the club's traditional look, featuring the classic crest and signature sponsor logos on the chest.
source.note: The same back-view launch photo shows the 'Coca-Cola' script at the bottom of the back of the shirt. The club's partners page lists Coca-Cola as a MAIN SPONSOR.

summary: 2026-27 Thai League 1 home kit, made in-house by the club and launched 6 July 2026 (Footy Headlines; the club sells it via buriram.shop). Chest: Chang central, Yamaha on the wearer's right chest; SAMART on the lower front hem; sleeves: Muang Thai Life (right) and Dunlopillo (left); back: AIS under the collar and Coca-Cola at the hem (from the launch-gallery photos). The shorts are not legible in any launch photo, and Buriram United wears a separate EGO Sport kit for the 2026-27 AFC Champions League Elite, so the list is not marked complete.
